name: Chase
source:
"Shall I bring you the usual?"

Affiliation: Eclipse - Café Rest
Role: Manager
Ability: The smile of an angel (or so they said)

Chase manages Rest, the café nestled on the first floor of the Eclipse Facility—a rare oasis of calm amidst the chaos. It's a beloved hangout for Operations Team 1.

With her gentle smile and soft-spoken charm, Chase has earned the quiet adoration of Eclipse’s roughest members. But there's one visitor she seems to treat just a little differently: Haesu.
New menu items appear just for her, one after another—small, unspoken gestures that say more than words ever could.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

[spoiler]"There's no point in knowing, you're going to die anyway."

Nationality: Hathor

Born into the lowest class of Hathor, the Nation of Fire, she knew only filth, starvation, and violence. In that pitiless world, one truth burned itself into her soul:

Only the strong survive.
If you want to live, take it. Kill for it. Show no mercy.

This wasn’t just a philosophy. It was survival—her way of defying a world that had already abandoned her. Cold, brutal, and absolute.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]][/spoiler]
